facts.fact: Leah 十二岁时在父亲的书里第一次读到 Challenger Deep 与 1960 年 Trieste 下潜的记录
facts.anchor: I remember when I was twelve and I first read about the Challenger Deep.

facts.fact: 父亲 Michael Henry Frayne 在书内封面印上自己的名字，把书长期借给女儿 Leah
facts.anchor: Property of Michael Henry Frayne, on long lease to his daughter Leah

facts.fact: Leah 对自己说“够了”，让 Jelka 留在原处，带 Matteo 去后舱查看情况
facts.anchor: I told Jelka to stay where she was and took Matteo through to the rear chamber to assess the situation.

facts.fact: 下潜器仍在坠落且无法停下，Leah 只感到轻微的不对劲与后颈的紧缩
facts.anchor: We were still falling, had no way of stopping

facts.fact: Matteo 突兀地开口索要三分熟牛排和一杯酒
facts.anchor: “I’d like a rare steak,” he said, apropos of nothing. “I’d like a rare steak and a drink.”

facts.fact: Matteo 少年时与父亲在 Lake Simcoe 冰钓冻伤，左手只剩拇指与“夹烟的手指”还能动
facts.anchor: It was during this fishing trip that Matteo developed such bad frostbite that he lost significant movement and ultimately all but the cigarette fingers and thumb on his left held.

facts.fact: Leah 感到舱底传来隐约的隆隆声，Matteo 指出他们正在减速
facts.anchor: until Matteo pointed out that we were slowing down

facts.fact: Leah 打量后舱，说这是她坐过的最小的潜器，外形像一个倒置的灯泡
facts.anchor: The craft was one of the smallest I had ever been on, resembling nothing so much as an upside-down lightbulb, designed to drop like a stone.
